___READ_ME___: Claude Code MCP config. Copy to <your-workspace>/.mcp.json and delete the ___ keys.
Paths are relative to the WORKSPACE ROOT (where you launch Claude Code), not to
this file. Windows: use forward slashes - they work and survive JSON escaping.
PITFALL 1 - the subcommand comes FIRST. args must begin with 'serve' before any
flag. Without it clap exits 2 and the server never completes an MCP handshake,
which the host reports only as a vague connection failure.
PITFALL 2 - do not mix command families. Either point `command` at the .exe and
pass its own flags, or point it at powershell/bash and pass script flags. Mixing
them (exe + -File ...) produces a process that starts and immediately dies.
PITFALL 3 - keep this file and .vscode/mcp.json in sync. They are separate files
